title: MNI Open iEEG Atlas: normal intracranial EEG in wakefulness and sleep (processed 200 Hz atlas clips)
description: Processed 200 Hz atlas clips from the MNI Open iEEG Atlas, comprising bipolar intracranial EEG (sEEG and ECoG) from 106 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy. Data cover one minute of artifact-free activity per vigilance state (wakefulness, N2, N3, REM) plus up to 10 minutes of N2 and N3 sleep, recorded from channels judged to show normal activity. Channels are localized in MNI space across 38 grey-matter regions. The authors' filtering, resampling and artifact-removal steps are retained, and segments are concatenated with zero buffers.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded during clinical presurgical evaluation at three tertiary epilepsy centres. The source authors applied an 80 Hz low-pass anti-aliasing filter and resampled to 200 Hz, then reduced power-line noise adaptively (1-min set). Artifacts were rejected visually, per-segment means were removed, and artifact-free segments were concatenated with 2-s zero buffers and zero-padded to a common length. Data were repacked losslessly into BrainVision float32 format.
